detail: Standard Oil (Indiana) distributed its holding of Standard Oil (NJ) shares (received in the 1932 sale of Pan American foreign properties) to its own shareholders in 1957; Indiana price fell from 61 1/8 (Jan) to 35 7/8 (Dec 1957). Size of the block not verified here.
source: B&Q Record Jan 1958 (Indiana price range); The Exchange Jul 1959; date approximate

detail: Court-ordered divestiture: du Pont distributed its ~63m GM shares (about 23% of GM) to its shareholders in instalments 1962-1965; du Pont market value fell from $12.1bn (end-1959) to $6.7bn (end-1966) partly for this reason. Share figure is the widely reported one, not re-verified.
source: widely reported (US v. du Pont, 1961); dates approximate

detail: Royal Dutch Petroleum 1-for-8 rights issue ($228.1m); NY-registered shares rose to 14,158,000 = ~21% of all shares (implied total ~67.4m 20-guilder shares).
